shortBio: Electronic powerhouse from Rotterdam. Known for his expensive musical taste and undeniable dancefloor energy, Donn Stone brings a culturally rich Afro-electronic sound rooted in the rhythms of the diaspora.
longBio:
Donn Stone is an electronic powerhouse from Rotterdam whose expensive musical taste and undeniable dancefloor energy have carved out a singular space in the Afro-electronic scene.

Rooted in the rhythms of the diaspora, his sound moves between raw and refined — from intimate club nights to festival main stages, always intentional, always cultural.

With a reputation built on consistency and feel, Donn Stone is one of Rotterdam's most compelling exports in contemporary electronic music.
